title: Scheduler journal hotfix R4 — correct sweep ledger contract + quota split, durable exclusion for corrupt shortlisted candidates (live-ops regression)
description: Live-ops hotfix + R1-R4 audit corrections. R0: eventsSince pages WHERE seq>? (hash-verify preserved); settle() wait_streak decays empty timed waits. R1-F1: fresh wakes reset next_due/wait_streak. R2-F1: usability predicate + lease exclusion pushed into uncharged SQL — unchanged cohorts converge silent at any size. R3-F1: bounded idle-path integrity sweep (uncharged ledger screen + rotating deep verify + dedup'd INTEGRITY_FAULT receipts). R4-F1: the ledger screen now matches the real canonical contract — revisions span 1..version with count==version and last_rev==version (writeSchedulerRow stamps revision=stored version; readSchedulerRow re-proves it); R3's last_rev!==v-1 falsely flagged every clean row. Receipted rows are excluded from the suspect list so confirmed suspects never re-consume the quota, and tier-2 deep verification keeps its own independent 16-row rotating quota — >=16 persistent suspects cannot starve coverage of later rows (bound: ceil(rows/16) idle calls). R4-F2: corrupt shortlisted rows were faulted but rescanned forever because the cursor rank comes from unverified payload; faults now durably exclude the ENTITY KEY via faulted_ids on FAIRNESS_STATE (validated like active_leases, capped 1024 -> fail-closed halt), plus a same-call skip set, so 64 corrupt shortlisted queues followed by one healthy candidate at rank 65 cannot starve it. Fairness write sites re-read the fairness row so mid-scan FAULT_EXCLUDE commits are never clobbered. Untouched: lease fencing/CAS/retry_count/generation accounting, dedup/idempotency, policy re-proofs, markDue polling, FAIR_VISIT/FAIR_ROUND decision receipts, per-row hash verification, claim() writer-lock re-proof. Evidence: 23 hotfix tests — failing-first on 7e85673 (drift undetected behind 16 suspects at cohorts 32/64; rank-65 starved; clean rows falsely screened); all green post-fix; adjacent 236/236; tsc clean; build green.
